name: 新莊妙妙廟 Temple Street Revived

meta.source: Sampled from the Temple Street Revived logo files (PNG, transparent and on white), 2026-10-03.

tokens.name: temple-red
tokens.usage: The red brush calligraphy of 新莊 in the logo. The brand's signature colour: headline accents, key buttons and solid feature blocks. As text it reads on cat-white (7.5:1) and feather-grey (5.5:1). cat-white text on it reads at 7.5:1.

tokens.name: ink-brown
tokens.usage: The TEMPLE_STREET_REVIVED wordmark and all of the logo's linework (the roof, scrolls and outlines). Default text colour for headings and body on cat-white (10.4:1), feather-grey (7.6:1) and dragon-gold (5.0:1).

tokens.name: door-brown
tokens.usage: The solid temple-door block at the centre of the logo. Use it for large solid fills such as footers, the door-shaped frames and stamp plates. Use cat-white text on it (10:1). It sits too close to ink-brown (1.04:1) to tell the two apart, so never set them next to each other as a contrast pair.

tokens.name: dragon-gold
tokens.usage: The two roof dragons and the round 莊 seal. A highlight colour for seals, stamps, small badges and decorative fills. It is NOT a text colour on light grounds (2.1:1 on cat-white). Set ink-brown text on it (5.0:1). On temple-red it only works for text 24px and up (3.6:1).

tokens.name: cat-white
tokens.usage: The winged temple cat, and the white ground the logo is supplied on. The page background and the text colour on temple-red and door-brown.

tokens.name: feather-grey
tokens.usage: The warm shading on the cat's wings and body. A secondary ground for tinted panels, cards and section bands. Text on it: ink-brown (7.6:1) or temple-red (5.5:1).

tokens.name: collar-grey
tokens.usage: The cat's collar. Use it for hairline rules, dividers and quiet icons (4.4:1 on cat-white, 3.2:1 on feather-grey). It misses 4.5:1 for body text on cat-white, so keep it to rules, icons and text 24px and up.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Alias of cat-white.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted panel or band on the page. Alias of feather-grey.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on surface and surface-tint. Alias of ink-brown.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand accent per view: a key button, a highlighted word, the active state. Alias of temple-red.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and door-brown fills. Alias of cat-white.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px rules, dividers and control borders on surface and surface-tint. Alias of collar-grey.

families.mincho: "GenRyuMin TW", "源流明體", "源流明朝", "Noto Serif TC", "Songti TC", serif
families.calligraphy: "可畫鶴舞金書繁", "GenRyuMin TW", "Noto Serif TC", serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Poster and cover headlines of two to six characters. 鶴舞金書 is a Canva-only face, so set these in Canva and export them as images. On the web this style falls back to GenRyuMin Bold.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Short calligraphic titles for social posts, standees and event headers. Use it once per layout, in temple-red or ink-brown.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page and section titles, ink-brown on surface.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Small headings, list headers and labels above blocks of body text.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 跟著妙妙貓走進廟口，認識老街的故事。
styles.usage: Running text in Chinese and English. The 1.75 line height leaves room for CJK.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: 林協記文化館 13:00 集合
styles.usage: Captions, credits, fine print and meta lines, in ink-brown (never collar-grey at this size).

styles.name: wordmark-caps
styles.usage: English all-caps labels that echo the logo's wordmark: kickers, category tags and the English line under a Chinese title. Type it in capitals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value, an icon and its text, or stacked lines in a tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Padding inside small cards and buttons, and the gap between paragraphs.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside panels and cards, and the gap between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The gap between sections, and the logo's minimum clear space at 280px logo width.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default: blocks, bands, images and panels stay square, like the temple's beams.

tokens.name: radius-door
tokens.usage: Taken from the barely softened corners of the logo's door block. Use it for buttons, cards, inputs and door-shaped frames.

tokens.name: radius-seal
tokens.usage: Taken from the round 莊 seal. Use it for circular seals, stamps, avatars and number badges.
